svg.title: Hasthiya IT
svg.desc: Hasthiya IT — Role: Full Stack Developer. Associate Software Engineer - Part Time (2023 Jun - 2024 Mar). I spearheaded web development using NodeJS, ExpressJS, ReactJS, and MySQL, while also contributing to mobile apps with Flutter and Firebase. Key Achievements: Developed and maintained multiple customer-facing web applications; Built responsive UI components with React and modern CSS frameworks; Implemented RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express; Created mobile applications using Flutter and Firebase integration.
